Renee: heads-up: planning hybrid unpin of model-family vec-quant tonight 22:30 PST — soft-unpin runtime 3.2 for performance tests, but keep model pinned to runtime 3.1 for traffic >200qps.

Omar: clarify the hybrid: runtime unpin only for low-throughput traffic?

Renee: yes — logic: route by qps threshold. low-qps routes -> runtime 3.2, high-qps -> stay on 3.1. Trying to gather perf gains without impacting heavy producers.

Kai: rollback triggers? need explicit metrics and an immediate revert command.

Renee: triggers: sustained 5xx >3% for 5m, 95th token latency increase >15% vs baseline for 10m, or any pod OOM. Revert command: `deploy revert --scope model-family vec-quant --runtime 3.1 --force`.

deploybot: unpin-request submitted by Renee at 2955554321. Canaries: vec-canary-1, vec-canary-2. Scheduled 2026-03-23T22:30:00-08:00.

qa-bot: ran acceptance & tokenization diffs: 0 mismatches on sample 800. Longseq regression check: 2/1000 flaky cases flagged.

Omar: capture flaky examples with telemetry flag `stalled_example=true`. Also add a sampling rule for full prompt bodies for those hits.

Renee: will enable telemetry sampling for any request matching stall signature. We'll redact PII.

Kai: operational ask: @oncall-eng-runtime take ownership for 90m. If trigger fires, call immediate revert and post incident stub. Also use `pinlist hold` if manual intervention needed.

oncall-eng-runtime: Ack. I'll monitor canaries and runbooks. Will escalate to #eng-releases on any trigger.

Renee: release notes draft: "Hybrid runtime unpin for vec-quant: runtime 3.2 soft-unpin for low-qps; heavy producers remain on 3.1. Telemetry and automatic rollback configured."

releasebot: release draft created and linked: /releases/2026-03-23-vec-quant-hybrid-unpin.

Kai: leaving a note to ops: `kubectl annotate route vec-quant route-change=hybrid-unpin-2955554321` and rollback snippet above.

Renee: final: proceeding at 22:30 PST. Will post ✅ after 2h observation. Thanks all.

deploybot: change executed at 2955554340: canaries updated (25% rollout to runtime 3.2).
